g.text: WING ROOT · BL 0 · LS(1)-0417MOD · INCIDENCE +1.4° · SCALE 1:10
WING TIP · BL 7,430 · LS(1)-0313 · INCIDENCE -2.6° · SCALE 1:10
SECTION AT BL 3,000 · CHORD 1,765 · FLAP 0° SOLID, 15° / 30° / 40° PHANTOM · SCALE 1:5
HARTZELL 5-BLADE · Ø2,670 · PLANFORM ABOUT THE PITCH AXIS, LE UP · SCALE 1:10
BLADE STATIONS (β FROM THE PLANE OF ROTATION)
RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA — NOT FOR MANUFACTURE
Dimensions in millimetres unless stated. Aerofoils drawn in their chord frame (chord line horizontal).
LS(1)-0417MOD / LS(1)-0313 sections are model reconstructions (CST fits to the sections of the Pilatus NGX model drawing), not certified ordinates.
Flap kinematics per model: rotation about the hinge at 0.73 c on the mean line, aft travel 0.20 c and drop 0.035 c, both proportional to deflection (full at 40°).
Blade chord, angle β and t/c measured from the lofted blade at flight-fine pitch (geometric pitch 2.9 m).
